moduleArDiscoverDesc: Discover points in a 360° image or camera view with the laser.
presetArDiscover_cameraDesc: Points in the real camera view on site
arDiscoverStartBody: Point your phone at your surroundings. Hold the laser on a point to discover it.
arDiscoverMotionDenied: Motion sensor not available – drag to look around.
arDiscoverCameraError: The camera is not available. You can still continue.
arDiscoverLoadError: The view could not be started. You can still continue.
arDiscoverAimHint: Hold the laser on a point
arDiscoverMapLabel: Area for placing points. Clicking adds a point, arrow keys move the selected point.
arDiscoverMapHint: Click the area to place a point. Drag to move it, arrow keys fine-tune (Shift = larger steps).
arDiscoverLiveHint: Drag the image until the center points at the spot you want, then place the point.
arDiscoverReferenceHint: A 360° photo of the location helps with placing. Visitors see their camera view on site.
arDiscoverRequireAll: Continue only after all points are discovered
arDiscoverRequireAllHint: Otherwise visitors can continue at any time.
arDiscoverIntroPlaceholderCamera: Stand in front of the gate and point your phone at the entrance.
arDiscoverCameraIntroHint: With a camera background the introduction describes the start view – points are placed relative to it.
